{{Quote|General staff meeting still scheduled to proceed on time, Admiral Motti?''"<br />"''As soon as the Grand Moff Tarkin arrives, General Tagge. He's gone to the docking bay to greet Lord Vader in person.|General Tagge and Admiral Motti|<ref name="SWR" />}}
The '''Imperial General Staff''' was a command-level organization within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] consisting of high-ranking [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]]. Shortly prior to the [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescue]] of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], members included [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]], and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]], and others.<ref name="SWR" />

An official military commander, Admiral [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]] was appointed to lead [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], a selection that appeased the high-ranking members of the Imperial General Staff.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>
